valuation.method: Forward diluted EPS x P/E, with EPS viewed at the 12-month target date (about FY2027, non-GAAP basis, the basis the market uses for SHOP). Listing is the US common line (USD), so no ADR or FX conversion is needed. Starting point: Q3 2026 revenue $3.742B (+32%), non-GAAP diluted EPS $0.49 and GAAP EPS $0.36 on 1,290.7M diluted weighted shares, free cash flow $816M (22% margin). Q4 2026 guidance: revenue growth in the low-thirties percent, gross profit growth in the high-twenties percent, opex 29-30% of revenue, FCF margin about the Q4 2025 level. The FY2027 EPS anchor of about $2.47 is a third-party figure implied by a 57x multiple at $140.80 in a November 3 2026 analysis; it is not company guidance. Scenario EPS and multiples are model assumptions.

bear.driver: Growth slows from low-thirties toward the high-twenties in 2027 as GMV growth and take-rate gains fade, and margin reset from marketing and infrastructure spending persists; the market pays less for a slower compounder

base.driver: Revenue growth holds near the high-twenties to low-thirties range through 2027, opex stays at about 29-30% of revenue, and FCF margin stays in the low-20s; the multiple stays near current levels

bull.driver: Merchant Solutions and payments attach keep growing faster than GMV, operating leverage lifts EPS toward the upper end of expectations, and the market keeps a premium growth multiple

valuation.implied_by_close: At base EPS $2.55 the $147.09 close implies 57.7x; a 12-month target of $185 (the one named call in the sample, National Bank) implies 72.5x at base EPS, or EPS about $3.08 at 60x (about 21% above the model)
valuation.sensitivity: One turn of P/E moves the base target by $2.55 (1.7 pp of the close); $0.10 of FY2027 EPS moves the base target by about $6 at 60x
valuation.watch_metric: Revenue growth against the low-thirties Q4 guide, paired with opex as a share of revenue (guided 29-30%) and FCF margin (Q3 22%, Q4 guided to about the prior-year level). A slip in growth below the high-twenties, or margin falling below the guide, would weaken the base case
valuation.next_disclosure: Q4 and full-year 2026 results, expected in February 2027 (date not confirmed in sources reviewed)

analyst_notes: Only one named broker in the sample has a dated 12-month call in the window that could be verified: National Bank Financial's Doug Taylor raised the target to $185 from $180 with an Outperform rating on November 5, 2026, after the roughly 5% fall on the Q3 GMV miss, arguing that the reset is a near-term margin issue. Other post-report actions (BMO, UBS, KeyBanc, CIBC, Robert W. Baird, Oppenheimer, RBC) were found only in aggregator or secondary sources with either no named analyst, no verifiable date, or a conflicting prior target, so they are excluded from events and from the weighted view. The sample therefore cannot support a recency-weighted consensus. The base case sits about 4% above the close, while the single named target sits about 26% above it, a gap that depends on EPS and multiple assumptions not yet visible in the sources.
